LOCAL EXPLORER

Analyze a repository in one step

Enter a local repository path or an HTTPS Git clone URL. This includes Azure DevOps Server/on-prem Git URLs. Analysis stays on this computer and reads Git history only.

Do not put credentials in the URL. URL credentials, SSH and non-HTTPS URLs are not supported; an already configured local Git credential manager may be used.

HOW IT WORKS

From evidence to investigation

  1. Acquire evidence
    Git history, pull requests, requirements, tests, builds and defect records may be collected locally.
  2. Normalize evidence
    Provider-specific records become bounded provider-neutral ECL evidence.
  3. Analyze
    Independent continuity, review, traceability, delivery, defect, build and verification dimensions remain separate.
  4. Generate Engineering System Review
    Create a standalone human-readable HTML review and machine-readable audit JSON.
  5. Investigate components
    Move from an executive finding to exact supporting evidence.

Two different kinds of engineering evidence

PR reviews record historical interactions around changes. Test observations declare an outcome for an exact test version and target. Neither establishes software quality or readiness.

Engineering Continuity Lab analyzes historical engineering activity as evidence of system continuity risk. These results do not measure employee performance, expertise, organizational value, or replaceability.

Report scope, export and filters

Git activity is only a proxy for knowledge. Scores and risk thresholds are experimental; review findings alongside team context.
